title: Looking to migrate my TOS script into an agentically trading platform, unsure how
author: wootinabox
selftext:
Hey all, I've been working on building a trading strategy within the ThinkOrSwim workspace using thinkscript, and have iterating on this little project for a little over 6 months now. The issue that I am running into is that the strategy is pretty sound, backtests feel good, but I (the human) am the problem. I find myself cutting early, fomoing after a losing trade, etc. I want to cut that part out and have my strategy migrated to something which agentically places my trades, and exits based on my rules for me. 

Not trying to shill what I made, this is more of a little project to see if I take the human out of trading, if my strategy works. 

The basic strategy is my bot 'trades' (and by trade, it gives me a signal and I do the manual trade) the 5m spy chart intraday. I take 2 options contracts 2-3dte around .65 to .75 delta, sell one at first call, and cut the second when my rising SL is triggered. Never swinging. I'd like to automate this, but I don't know the best way to do that in real time, or platform that would help me achieve what I want. Any advice, or suggestions on where to look would be greatly appreciated.

  
Image of what I see when I enter a trade. Honestly very proud of it so far.
